insights.title: Customer concentration risk
insights.recommendation: Protect the account while increasing revenue from secondary customers.

insights.title: High-growth market: Rwanda
insights.finding: Rwanda revenue increased by 43.4% between the first and last six months.
insights.recommendation: Evaluate additional sales capacity, inventory and customer acquisition investment in Rwanda.

insights.title: Revenue decline in Uganda
insights.finding: Uganda revenue changed by -18.7% between the first and last six months.
insights.recommendation: Investigate customer losses, product mix and sales activity in Uganda.

insights.title: Elevated overdue revenue
insights.recommendation: Prioritize collections, review customer credit exposure and monitor overdue balances.

insights.title: Product concentration: Carrier Router
insights.finding: Carrier Router generates 26.8% of total revenue.
insights.recommendation: Protect availability and margins while developing adjacent revenue streams.
